name: Example: Scheduled poll (app trigger pattern)
description: The poll pattern: instead of a native 'new article' trigger, a cron schedule (weekdays 9am New York time) fires the run and the first step polls the source — here an RSS feed. Swap the RSS node for any connector (email, API, database) to emulate an app-specific trigger. Save the workflow to activate the schedule, or run it manually anytime. No API keys needed.
